BottomSheet.usage: Global bottom sheet system. Use presets for every page-triggered mobile sheet. Height decisions must follow src/design-public-assets/overlays/registry/bottom-sheet-design-principles.md and choose heightMode='adaptive', 'fixed', or 'fullscreen'. Adaptive is for action menus, short forms, short confirmations, and detail sheets: the Panel grows from Header + Content + Footer, maxes at 90dvh, and only Content scrolls when over height. Fixed is for page-like sheets, long selections, complex local flows, and explicit legacy snapPoints/contentSizing='fill': Panel height is 90dvh and Content uses the remaining middle space. Fullscreen is for full-screen modal-equivalent flows: Panel height is 100dvh, radius is removed, and Content fills the middle area with safe-area aware Footer. Header, Content, and Footer must render as direct children inside one Panel; Footer is in normal layout flow with flex: 0 0 auto, not footerComponent, portal, fixed, or absolute. Footer bottom padding is `layout.sheetFooterPaddingBottom + useSafeAreaInsets().bottom`, so the Footer background covers the system safe area and buttons do not sit on the iOS Home Indicator or Android gesture area. ContentInner bottom padding uses `layout.sheetContentPaddingBottom` so the final scroll item keeps breathing space before the in-flow Footer. Opening or stacking a sheet dismisses the active keyboard and releases input focus before presentation. Backdrop tap, close button, optional pan-down, Android back, cancel action, and business-completion close all use the shared closeModal lifecycle, and cleanup happens only after the Panel dismisses. Route-backed or dirty-state sheets may supply onRequestClose to block dismissal until a registered guard or route close pipeline resolves; callers may update the active sheet with the public update method instead of re-presenting it on every state change. Header left/right inset uses `layout.topBarPaddingX` at 16px. Card content uses `layout.contentCardPaddingX` at 12px. List content, article/detail introduction content, and normal descriptive content use `layout.sheetContentPaddingX` at 16px. Footer left/right inset uses `layout.bottomActionArea.paddingX` at 16px and stacked Footer actions use `layout.sheetFooterGap` at 12px. Card content keeps the gray `sheetSurface='canvas'` bed (`color.surface.canvas`) with white `color.surface.panel` card bodies; plain/list content uses `sheetSurface='panel'` so picker, selection, and list sheets sit on a white bed. The selection preset defaults to this panel surface. Card-based selection sheets such as TradingAccountContextSwitcher explicitly use `sheetSurface='canvas'` and `contentPadding='card'` because account options are selectable cards on a gray bed. Flush content is reserved for public business components that own their full internal surface and spacing. Every page-level bottom sheet must be opened through useBottomSheet with bottomSheetPresets.selection/detail/actionMenu or a registered business sheet wrapper exported from design-public-assets. Route-backed Modal Page Sheets such as the order ticket may keep the route for recovery while rendering the visible operation surface through GlobalBottomSheetHost.
